summary:
We developed an illustrated digital storybook that aims to raise awareness of NASA’s abandoned equipment and objects left behind on Mars.

Through the fictional adventure of a young astronaut named Kris and his AI assistant, Milo, readers follow their journey to explore the red planet and discover objects left behind by earlier space missions. By combining imaginative storytelling, creative illustrations and educational information based on NASA’s research and mission records, our project highlights the history and significance of these forgotten objects.

Designed for children aged 7–12, the storybook makes space exploration easier to understand and more engaging. It addresses the challenge by giving abandoned space equipment a story and helping younger generations recognise that these objects are more than just discarded technology. They are reminders of humanity's achievements, discoveries and continuing efforts to explore the universe.
details: Our project allows young reader range from 7-12 years old to explore the history of abandoned objects left behind by previous Mars mission through digital storytelling experience. By following Kris and his spacecraft AI assistant, Milo, readers can discover these objects and learn about their original purpose, historical backgrounds on mars and contributions to our current space exploration. It also presents scientific informations in simple and engaging way,helping children understand the importance of these objects and the missions behind them. Our project makes learning about Mars exploration more accessible to children. It introduces scientific concepts and the history of previous space missions through simple language and illustrations. It also encourages curiosity and interest in space exploration. We hope to raise awareness about the objects left behind by previous Mar missions and help younger generations appreciate their historical and scientific significance to the world. We want readers to understand that all abandoned objects left in mars represent important achivements in humanity’s space exploration be it big or small. Our team used ibis paint X to create the illustration of our storybook, and Canva to arrange everything in a digital book style. Our project combines fictional storytelling with real scientific information, instead of presenting just facts about the abandoned space equipment through ordinary explanations, we introduced them through the adventures of Kris and Milo. This approach makes learning more imaginative, engaging and memorable for young readers. Our team had already considered the target audienceʼs age range, reading ability and understanding of scientific concepts in easier way to be absorb. Since the storybook is designed for kids aged 7-12,we aim to use simple language, engaging illustrations and clear explanations while keeping scientific informations accurate. Kids may be able to learn a few new things and new words by reading the illustration we used.
